title: Schemark Configuration
description: Meta-schema for schemark.json files. Each schemark.json describes the directly-owned subdirectories and files, with support for nested definitions that can be overridden by child schemark.json files.

$schema.description: Pointer to this meta-schema, enables IDE assistance.

strict.description: When true, any direct child not matched by directories/files is illegal.

directories.description: Rules for direct child directories of this directory.

files.description: Rules for direct child files of this directory.

typeKey.description: kebab-case identifier; surfaces as the auto-injected `type` field for files.

namespaceName.description: Mount point in the derived meta tree.

captureGroupName.description: Identifier for a JS regex named capture group; must not collide with the auto-injected `type` field.

jsonSchemaFieldDef.description: Subset of JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 used to describe a single field. Tools MAY accept additional standard JSON Schema keywords beyond those listed; unknown keywords are passed through to the underlying validator.

metaSpec.description: Describes how regex captures from the matched name flow into the derived meta object, with JSON Schema validation.

fields.description: Keys are regex capture group names; values are JSON Schema definitions.

required.description: Capture group names that MUST be present and non-empty after matching.

frontmatterSpec.description: Describes which fields to extract from YAML frontmatter and their JSON Schema validation.

fields.description: Keys are frontmatter field names; values are JSON Schema definitions.

required.description: Frontmatter field names that MUST be present in the YAML block.

pattern.description: JS-flavored regex with optional named capture groups; matched against the bare directory name.

directories.description: Nested directory rules for this directory's children. Inherited if no schemark.json exists in the matched directory.

files.description: Nested file rules for this directory's children. Inherited if no schemark.json exists in the matched directory.

pattern.description: JS-flavored regex matched against the bare file name (e.g. meeting-20260415-站会纪要.md).
